s.id, s.game_session_id, s.activity_id, s.node_id, s.node_name, s.station_code, s.merchant_member_id, s.source_type, s.source_id, s.status, s.preparation_snapshot_json, s.capacity, s.service_start_at, s.service_end_at, s.pause_reason_code, s.pause_reason, s.resume_eta, s.fallback_node_id, s.fallback_plan_code, s.fallback_plan_version, s.revision, s.create_time, s.update_time, (select count(1) from game_task_submission q where q.station_run_id=s.id and q.status='PENDING') as pending_verification_count
exists (select 1 from cms_registration reg where reg.member_id=m.member_id and reg.owner_type=2 and reg.owner_id=t.owner_id and reg.payment_status=2 and reg.registration_status=2)
mapper.select: select distinct t.id from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.status=1 where t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=#{activityId} and t.status in (0,1,2) and order by t.id
select from game_session where activity_id=#{activityId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert ignore into game_session (activity_id, topic_id, club_id, module_config_snapshot_json, status, current_chapter_id, revision, prepared_by, started_by, finished_by, started_at, finished_at, leaderboard_visible, leaderboard_updated_by, leaderboard_updated_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{activityId}, #{topicId}, #{clubId}, #{moduleConfigSnapshotJson}, #{status}, #{currentChapterId}, #{revision}, #{preparedBy}, #{startedBy}, #{finishedBy}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{leaderboardVisible}, #{leaderboardUpdatedBy}, #{leaderboardUpdatedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update game_session set current_chapter_id=coalesce(#{currentChapterId}, current_chapter_id), started_by=case when #{toStatus}='RUNNING' and status<>'RUNNING' then #{actorMemberId} else started_by end, started_at=case when #{toStatus}='RUNNING' and status<>'RUNNING' then #{now} else started_at end, finished_by=case when #{toStatus}='FINISHED' then #{actorMemberId} else finished_by end, finished_at=case when #{toStatus}='FINISHED' then #{now} else finished_at end, status=#{toStatus}, revision=revision+1, update_time=#{now} where id=#{id} and revision=#{expectedRevision} and status=#{fromStatus} and status not in ('FINISHED','CANCELLED')
mapper.select: select from game_session where activity_id=#{activityId} for update

select count(distinct prior.merchant_member_id) from ( select s.activity_id, s.topic_id, case when fallback.id is not null then fallback.merchant_member_id else station.merchant_member_id end as merchant_member_id from game_session s join game_station_run station on station.game_session_id=s.id join cms_topic_node previous on previous.id=station.node_id and previous.topic_id=s.topic_id join cms_topic_node target on target.id=#{nodeId} and target.topic_id=s.topic_id left join cms_topic_node fallback on fallback.id=station.fallback_node_id and fallback.topic_id=s.topic_id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.club_id > 0 and coalesce(previous.sort_id,0) < coalesce(target.sort_id,0) ) prior where prior.merchant_member_id > 0 and not exists ( select 1 from coop_group_verify receipt where receipt.activity_id=prior.activity_id and receipt.topic_id=prior.topic_id and receipt.merchant_member_id=prior.merchant_member_id )
mapper.update: update game_station_run set status='READY', service_start_at=#{startAt}, service_end_at=#{endAt}, update_time=#{now}, revision=revision+1 where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and source_type='HOST_NODE' and merchant_member_id is null and status='INVITED'
mapper.select: select t.id as teamId, coalesce(t.title, '队伍') as teamName, count(distinct m.member_id) as memberCount, count(distinct p.node_id) as completedNodes, (select count(1) from game_station_run sr where sr.game_session_id=s.id) as totalNodes, case when count(distinct p.node_id) >= (select count(1) from game_station_run sr where sr.game_session_id=s.id) then 'COMPLETED' when count(p.id) > 0 then 'RUNNING' else 'PREPARING' end as status from game_session s join play_team t on t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=s.activity_id and t.status in (0,1,2) join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.status=1 join cms_registration reg on reg.member_id=m.member_id and reg.owner_type=2 and reg.owner_id=s.activity_id and reg.payment_status=2 and reg.registration_status=2 left join player_node_progress p on p.member_id=m.member_id and p.activity_id=s.activity_id and p.topic_id=s.topic_id and p.status=1 and p.del_flag=0 and exists (select 1 from game_station_run sr where sr.game_session_id=s.id and sr.node_id=p.node_id) where s.id=#{sessionId} group by s.id, t.id, t.title
mapper.insert: insert ignore into game_station_run (game_session_id, activity_id, node_id, node_name, station_code, merchant_member_id, source_type, source_id, status, revision, create_time, update_time) select #{sessionId}, #{activityId}, n.id, n.name, concat('NODE_', n.id), coalesce(n.merchant_member_id, rm.member_id), case when n.merchant_member_id is not null then 'CHAPTER_NODE' when rm.id is not null then 'REGISTRATION_WINNER' else 'HOST_NODE' end, case when n.merchant_member_id is not null then n.id when rm.id is not null then rm.id else n.id end, 'INVITED', 0, #{now}, #{now} from cms_topic_node n left join cms_registration_merchant rm on rm.id=(select min(rm2.id) from cms_registration_merchant rm2 where rm2.topic_id=#{topicId} and rm2.node_id=n.id and rm2.audit_status=1 and rm2.status=1 and rm2.del_flag=0) where n.topic_id=#{topicId} and n.status=1 and (n.merchant_member_id is null or n.node_audit_status=1) and not exists (select 1 from merchant_chapter_offer withdrawn where withdrawn.chapter_id = n.chapter_id and withdrawn.merchant_id = n.merchant_member_id and withdrawn.status = 0 and withdrawn.withdraw_reason is not null and trim(withdrawn.withdraw_reason) != '')
mapper.update: update game_station_run set station_code=#{stationCode} where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and node_id=#{nodeId}
mapper.select: select from game_station_run s where s.game_session_id=#{sessionId} order by s.id

select r.id as stationRunId, (select count(distinct p.member_id) from player_node_progress p where p.activity_id=r.activity_id and p.topic_id=s.topic_id and p.node_id=r.node_id and p.checkin_time is not null and p.del_flag=0 and exists ( select 1 from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.member_id=p.member_id and m.status=1 where t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=r.activity_id and t.status in (0,1,2) and )) as arrivedPlayers, (select count(1) from game_task_submission q where q.game_session_id=r.game_session_id and q.station_run_id=r.id) as submissionCount, (select count(case when q.status='APPROVED' then 1 end) from game_task_submission q where q.game_session_id=r.game_session_id and q.station_run_id=r.id) as approvedCount, (select count(case when q.status='REJECTED' then 1 end) from game_task_submission q where q.game_session_id=r.game_session_id and q.station_run_id=r.id) as rejectedCount, (select count(case when q.status='RECORDED' then 1 end) from game_task_submission q where q.game_session_id=r.game_session_id and q.station_run_id=r.id) as recordedCount, (select count(case when o.status='COMPLETED' then 1 end) from game_player_node_outcome o where o.game_session_id=r.game_session_id and o.station_run_id=r.id) as normalCompletedCount, (select count(case when o.status='FALLBACK_COMPLETED' then 1 end) from game_player_node_outcome o where o.game_session_id=r.game_session_id and o.station_run_id=r.id) as fallbackCompletedCount, (select count(1) from game_command_receipt c where c.game_session_id=r.game_session_id and c.node_id=r.node_id and c.actor_member_id=r.merchant_member_id and c.actor_perspective='MERCHANT' and c.action='STATION_PAUSE' and c.outcome='APPLIED') as pauseEventCount, 0 as authorizedContentCount, 'NO_PUBLIC_CONTENT' as contentPolicy from game_station_run r join game_session s on s.id=r.game_session_id where r.game_session_id=#{sessionId} and r.merchant_member_id=#{merchantMemberId} order by r.id

select r.activity_id as activityId, s.topic_id as topicId, a.name as activityName, a.start_date as startAt, a.end_date as endAt, count(distinct r.id) as stationCount from game_station_run r join game_session s on s.id=r.game_session_id and s.activity_id=r.activity_id join cms_activity a on a.id=r.activity_id and a.del_flag=0 where r.merchant_member_id=#{merchantMemberId} group by r.activity_id, s.topic_id, a.name, a.start_date, a.end_date order by a.start_date desc, r.activity_id desc
select from game_station_run s where s.game_session_id=#{sessionId} and s.node_id=#{nodeId} limit 1
mapper.update: update game_station_run target left join game_station_run blocker on blocker.game_session_id=target.game_session_id and (blocker.status<>'READY' or blocker.service_start_at is null or blocker.service_end_at is null or blocker.service_start_at>#{now} or blocker.service_end_at<=#{now}) set target.status='ACTIVE', target.revision=target.revision+1, target.update_time=#{now} where target.game_session_id=#{sessionId} and target.status='READY' and target.service_start_at<=#{now} and target.service_end_at>#{now} and blocker.id is null
update game_station_run set status='CLOSED', revision=revision+1, update_time=#{now} where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and status<>'CLOSED'
mapper.select: select count(1) from game_station_run where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and status<>'READY'

select count(distinct t.id) from play_team t where t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=#{activityId} and t.status in (0,1,2) and exists (select 1 from play_team_member m where m.team_id=t.id and m.status=1 and )

select count(1) from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.status=1 left join game_team_role_assignment r on r.game_session_id=#{sessionId} and r.team_id=t.id and r.member_id=m.member_id and r.status='CONFIRMED' where t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=#{activityId} and t.status in (0,1,2) and and r.id is null

select t.id from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.member_id=#{memberId} and m.status=1 where t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=#{activityId} and t.status in (0,1,2) order by t.id desc limit 1

select count(1) from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.member_id=#{memberId} and m.status=1 where t.id=#{teamId} and t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=#{activityId} and t.status in (0,1,2) and
select count(1) from play_team where id=#{teamId} and owner_type=2 and owner_id=#{activityId} and status in (0,1,2)

select id, game_session_id, team_id, member_id, role_code, role_name, status, assigned_by, superseded_by, superseded_at, revision, create_time, update_time from game_team_role_assignment where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and member_id=#{memberId} and status in ('ASSIGNED','CONFIRMED') limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert ignore into game_team_role_assignment (game_session_id, team_id, member_id, role_code, role_name, status, assigned_by, superseded_by, superseded_at, revision, create_time, update_time) values (#{gameSessionId}, #{teamId}, #{memberId}, #{roleCode}, #{roleName}, #{status}, #{assignedBy}, #{supersededBy}, #{supersededAt}, #{revision}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update game_team_role_assignment set status=#{toStatus}, revision=revision+1, update_time=#{now} where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and member_id=#{memberId} and status=#{fromStatus}
mapper.select: select id, game_session_id, team_id, member_id, role_code, role_name, status, assigned_by, superseded_by, superseded_at, revision, create_time, update_time from game_team_role_assignment where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and member_id=#{memberId} and status in ('ASSIGNED','CONFIRMED') order by id desc limit 1

select id, game_session_id, team_id, member_id, role_code, role_name, status, assigned_by, superseded_by, superseded_at, revision, create_time, update_time from game_team_role_assignment where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and status in ('ASSIGNED','CONFIRMED') order by team_id, id

select t.id as teamId, coalesce(t.title, '队伍') as teamName, m.member_id as memberId, coalesce(u.nickname, '玩家') as memberName, r.role_code as roleCode, r.role_name as roleName, r.status from game_session s join play_team t on t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=s.activity_id and t.status in (0,1,2) join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.status=1 left join ums_member u on u.id=m.member_id left join game_team_role_assignment r on r.game_session_id=s.id and r.team_id=t.id and r.member_id=m.member_id and r.status in ('ASSIGNED','CONFIRMED') where s.id=#{sessionId} and order by t.id, m.id

select t.id as teamId, coalesce(t.title, '队伍') as teamName, count(distinct m.member_id) as memberCount, count(distinct case when o.status in ('COMPLETED','FALLBACK_COMPLETED') then o.node_id end) as completedNodes, (select count(1) from game_station_run sr where sr.game_session_id=s.id) as totalNodes, stuck.node_id as currentStuckNodeId, stuck.node_name as currentStuckNodeName, stuck.status as currentStuckStationStatus, stuck_submission.status as currentStuckSubmissionStatus, (select max(cast(json_unquote(json_extract(hint.result_json, '$.hint.currentLevel')) as unsigned)) from game_command_receipt hint join play_team_member hint_member on hint_member.team_id=t.id and hint_member.member_id=hint.actor_member_id and hint_member.status=1 where hint.game_session_id=s.id and hint.node_id=stuck.node_id and hint.action='PLAYER_HINT' and hint.outcome='APPLIED' and json_valid(hint.result_json)=1 and json_extract(hint.result_json, '$.hint.currentLevel') is not null and exists (select 1 from cms_registration hint_reg where hint_reg.member_id=hint_member.member_id and hint_reg.owner_type=2 and hint_reg.owner_id=t.owner_id and hint_reg.payment_status=2 and hint_reg.registration_status=2)) as hintLevel, recent_event.request_id as recentEventRequestId, recent_event.action as recentEventAction, recent_event.outcome as recentEventOutcome, recent_event.reason_code as recentEventReasonCode, recent_event.revision as recentEventRevision, recent_event.update_time as recentEventAt, case when (select count(1) from game_station_run sr where sr.game_session_id=s.id) > 0 and count(distinct case when o.status in ('COMPLETED','FALLBACK_COMPLETED') then o.node_id end) >= (select count(1) from game_station_run sr where sr.game_session_id=s.id) then 'COMPLETED' when stuck.status in ('PAUSED','CLOSED') or stuck_submission.status in ('PENDING','REJECTED') then 'BLOCKED' when count(o.id) > 0 or recent_event.id is not null then 'RUNNING' else 'PREPARING' end as status from game_session s join play_team t on t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=s.activity_id and t.status in (0,1,2) join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.status=1 left join game_player_node_outcome o on o.game_session_id=s.id and o.team_id=t.id left join game_station_run stuck on stuck.id=( select sr.id from game_station_run sr where sr.game_session_id=s.id and not exists ( select 1 from game_player_node_outcome done where done.game_session_id=s.id and done.team_id=t.id and done.node_id=sr.node_id) order by case sr.status when 'PAUSED' then 0 when 'CLOSED' then 1 when 'ACTIVE' then 2 when 'READY' then 3 when 'ACCEPTED' then 4 when 'INVITED' then 5 else 6 end, sr.id limit 1) left join game_task_submission stuck_submission on stuck_submission.id=( select submitted.id from game_task_submission submitted where submitted.game_session_id=s.id and submitted.team_id=t.id and submitted.node_id=stuck.node_id order by submitted.id desc limit 1) left join game_command_receipt recent_event on recent_event.id=( select recent.id from game_command_receipt recent join play_team_member m_recent on recent.actor_member_id=m_recent.member_id and m_recent.team_id=t.id and m_recent.status=1 where recent.game_session_id=s.id and recent.actor_perspective='PLAYER' and recent.outcome in ('APPLIED','FAILED') and exists (select 1 from cms_registration recent_reg where recent_reg.member_id=m_recent.member_id and recent_reg.owner_type=2 and recent_reg.owner_id=t.owner_id and recent_reg.payment_status=2 and recent_reg.registration_status=2) order by recent.id desc limit 1) where s.id=#{sessionId} and group by s.id, t.id, t.title, stuck.node_id, stuck.node_name, stuck.status, stuck_submission.status, recent_event.id, recent_event.request_id, recent_event.action, recent_event.outcome, recent_event.reason_code, recent_event.revision, recent_event.update_time order by t.id

select json_extract(c.result_json, '$.recap') from game_command_receipt c join game_session s on s.id=c.game_session_id and s.activity_id=c.activity_id where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.status='FINISHED' and c.action='FINISH' and c.outcome='APPLIED' and c.revision=s.revision and json_valid(c.result_json)=1 and json_unquote(json_extract(c.result_json, '$.recap.schemaVersion'))='GAME_RECAP_V1' order by c.id desc limit 1

select (select count(distinct reg.member_id) from cms_registration reg where reg.owner_type=2 and reg.owner_id=s.activity_id and reg.payment_status=2 and reg.registration_status=2 and exists ( select 1 from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.member_id=reg.member_id and m.status=1 where t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=s.activity_id and t.status in (0,1,2) )) as paidPlayers, (select count(distinct p.member_id) from player_node_progress p where p.activity_id=s.activity_id and p.topic_id=s.topic_id and p.checkin_time is not null and p.del_flag=0 and exists ( select 1 from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.member_id=p.member_id and m.status=1 where t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=s.activity_id and t.status in (0,1,2) and )) as arrivedPlayers, (select count(distinct q.member_id) from game_task_submission q where q.game_session_id=s.id) as taskSubmitters, case when json_unquote(json_extract(s.module_config_snapshot_json, '$.playMode'))='ROUTE' then (select count(distinct p.member_id) from player_node_progress p where p.activity_id=s.activity_id and p.topic_id=s.topic_id and p.status=1 and p.del_flag=0 and exists (select 1 from game_station_run sr where sr.game_session_id=s.id and sr.node_id=p.node_id) and exists (select 1 from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.member_id=p.member_id and m.status=1 where t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=s.activity_id and t.status in (0,1,2) and )) else (select count(distinct case when o.status='COMPLETED' then o.member_id end) from game_player_node_outcome o where o.game_session_id=s.id) end as normalCompleters, (select count(distinct case when o.status='FALLBACK_COMPLETED' then o.member_id end) from game_player_node_outcome o where o.game_session_id=s.id) as fallbackCompleters, (select count(distinct t.id) from play_team t where t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=s.activity_id and t.status in (0,1,2) and exists (select 1 from play_team_member m where m.team_id=t.id and m.status=1 and ) and (select count(1) from game_station_run sr where sr.game_session_id=s.id) > 0 and case when json_unquote(json_extract(s.module_config_snapshot_json, '$.playMode'))='ROUTE' then (select count(distinct p.node_id) from player_node_progress p join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.member_id=p.member_id and m.status=1 where p.activity_id=s.activity_id and p.topic_id=s.topic_id and p.status=1 and p.del_flag=0 and and exists (select 1 from game_station_run sr where sr.game_session_id=s.id and sr.node_id=p.node_id)) else (select count(distinct o.node_id) from game_player_node_outcome o where o.game_session_id=s.id and o.team_id=t.id and o.status in ('COMPLETED','FALLBACK_COMPLETED')) end >= (select count(1) from game_station_run sr where sr.game_session_id=s.id) ) as finishedTeams, (select count(1) from game_command_receipt c where c.game_session_id=s.id and c.action='PLAYER_HINT' and c.outcome='APPLIED' and json_valid(c.result_json)=1 and cast(json_unquote(json_extract(c.result_json, '$.hint.currentLevel')) as unsigned)=1 ) as level1Uses, (select count(1) from game_command_receipt c where c.game_session_id=s.id and c.action='PLAYER_HINT' and c.outcome='APPLIED' and json_valid(c.result_json)=1 and cast(json_unquote(json_extract(c.result_json, '$.hint.currentLevel')) as unsigned)=2 ) as level2Uses, (select count(1) from game_command_receipt c where c.game_session_id=s.id and c.action='PLAYER_REVEAL' and c.outcome='APPLIED' ) as answerReveals, (select count(1) from game_command_receipt c where c.game_session_id=s.id and c.action in ('STATION_PAUSE','CLUB_STATION_PAUSE') and c.outcome='APPLIED' ) as merchantPauseEvents, (select count(1) from game_player_node_outcome o where o.game_session_id=s.id and o.status='FALLBACK_COMPLETED' and o.completion_source='FALLBACK_PLAN') as merchantFallbackCompletions, (select count(1) from game_task_submission q where q.game_session_id=s.id and q.status='REJECTED') as playerRejectedSubmissions, (select count(1) from game_command_receipt c where c.game_session_id=s.id and c.action='TAKEOVER_ROLE' and c.outcome='APPLIED' ) as takeoverCount from game_session s where s.id=#{sessionId} and s.activity_id=#{activityId}

select r.node_id as nodeId, r.node_name as nodeName, (select count(distinct p.member_id) from player_node_progress p where p.activity_id=r.activity_id and p.topic_id=s.topic_id and p.node_id=r.node_id and p.checkin_time is not null and p.del_flag=0 and exists ( select 1 from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.member_id=p.member_id and m.status=1 where t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=r.activity_id and t.status in (0,1,2) and )) as arrivedPlayers, (select count(1) from game_task_submission q where q.game_session_id=r.game_session_id and q.station_run_id=r.id) as submissionCount, case when json_unquote(json_extract(s.module_config_snapshot_json, '$.playMode'))='ROUTE' then (select count(distinct p.member_id) from player_node_progress p where p.activity_id=r.activity_id and p.topic_id=s.topic_id and p.node_id=r.node_id and p.status=1 and p.del_flag=0 and exists (select 1 from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.member_id=p.member_id and m.status=1 where t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=r.activity_id and t.status in (0,1,2) and )) else (select count(case when o.status='COMPLETED' then 1 end) from game_player_node_outcome o where o.game_session_id=r.game_session_id and o.station_run_id=r.id) end as normalCompletedCount, (select count(case when o.status='FALLBACK_COMPLETED' then 1 end) from game_player_node_outcome o where o.game_session_id=r.game_session_id and o.station_run_id=r.id) as fallbackCompletedCount, (select count(case when q.status='REJECTED' then 1 end) from game_task_submission q where q.game_session_id=r.game_session_id and q.station_run_id=r.id) as rejectedCount, (select count(1) from game_command_receipt c where c.game_session_id=r.game_session_id and c.node_id=r.node_id and c.action in ('STATION_PAUSE','CLUB_STATION_PAUSE') and c.outcome='APPLIED') as pauseEventCount from game_station_run r join game_session s on s.id=r.game_session_id where r.game_session_id=#{sessionId} order by r.id

select t.id as teamId, count(distinct case when r.status='CONFIRMED' then r.role_code end) as assignedRoleCount, count(distinct case when r.status in ('CONFIRMED','SUPERSEDED') and o.id is not null then r.role_code end) as contributedRoleCount from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.status=1 left join game_team_role_assignment r on r.game_session_id=#{sessionId} and r.team_id=t.id and r.member_id=m.member_id left join game_player_node_outcome o on o.game_session_id=#{sessionId} and o.team_id=t.id and o.member_id=m.member_id and o.status in ('COMPLETED','FALLBACK_COMPLETED') where t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=#{activityId} and t.status in (0,1,2) and group by t.id order by t.id

select id, game_session_id, owner_type, owner_id, variables_json, applied_choices_json, ending_code, status, revision, create_time, update_time from game_story_state where game_session_id=#{sessionId} order by owner_type, owner_id

select id, game_session_id, owner_type, owner_id, variables_json, applied_choices_json, ending_code, status, revision, create_time, update_time from game_story_state where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and owner_type=#{ownerType} and owner_id=#{ownerId} limit 1

select id, game_session_id, owner_type, owner_id, variables_json, applied_choices_json, ending_code, status, revision, create_time, update_time from game_story_state where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and owner_type=#{ownerType} and owner_id=#{ownerId} limit 1 for update

mapper.select: select id, game_session_id, activity_id, node_id, actor_member_id, actor_perspective, request_id, request_hash, action, outcome, reason_code, revision, result_json, create_time, update_time from game_command_receipt where activity_id=#{activityId} and actor_member_id=#{actorMemberId} and request_id=#{requestId} limit 1

select id, game_session_id, activity_id, node_id, actor_member_id, actor_perspective, request_id, request_hash, action, outcome, reason_code, revision, result_json, create_time, update_time from game_command_receipt where activity_id=#{activityId} and actor_member_id=#{actorMemberId} and request_id=#{requestId} limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert ignore into game_command_receipt (game_session_id, activity_id, node_id, actor_member_id, actor_perspective, request_id, request_hash, action, outcome, reason_code, revision, result_json, create_time, update_time) values (#{gameSessionId}, #{activityId}, #{nodeId}, #{actorMemberId}, #{actorPerspective}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, #{action}, #{outcome}, #{reasonCode}, #{revision}, #{resultJson}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update game_command_receipt set result_json=#{resultJson}, update_time=#{updateTime} where id=#{id} and outcome='APPLIED' and request_hash=#{requestHash}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into game_task_submission (game_session_id, activity_id, station_run_id, node_id, team_id, member_id, task_code, evidence_json, status, decided_by, decision_reason_code, decision_reason, revision, create_time, update_time) values (#{gameSessionId}, #{activityId}, #{stationRunId}, #{nodeId}, #{teamId}, #{memberId}, #{taskCode}, #{evidenceJson}, #{status}, #{decidedBy}, #{decisionReasonCode}, #{decisionReason}, #{revision}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, game_session_id, activity_id, station_run_id, node_id, team_id, member_id, task_code, evidence_json, status, decided_by, decision_reason_code, decision_reason, revision, create_time, update_time from game_task_submission where id=#{id} limit 1

select s.id as submissionId, s.node_id as nodeId, r.node_name as nodeName, s.team_id as teamId, s.status as status, s.decision_reason as decisionReason, s.update_time as updatedAt from game_task_submission s left join game_station_run r on r.id = s.station_run_id where s.game_session_id = #{sessionId} and s.status in ('PENDING', 'REJECTED') order by s.update_time desc, s.id desc limit 50

select id, game_session_id, activity_id, station_run_id, node_id, team_id, member_id, task_code, evidence_json, status, decided_by, decision_reason_code, decision_reason, revision, create_time, update_time from game_task_submission where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and member_id=#{memberId} and node_id=#{nodeId} and task_code=#{taskCode} and status in ('PENDING','APPROVED','RECORDED') order by id desc limit 1

select id, game_session_id, activity_id, station_run_id, node_id, team_id, member_id, task_code, evidence_json, status, decided_by, decision_reason_code, decision_reason, revision, create_time, update_time from game_task_submission where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and member_id=#{memberId} and node_id=#{nodeId} and task_code=#{taskCode} and status in ('PENDING','APPROVED','RECORDED') order by id desc limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert ignore into game_player_node_outcome (game_session_id, activity_id, station_run_id, node_id, team_id, member_id, status, completion_source, source_submission_id, source_receipt_id, fallback_plan_code, fallback_plan_version, completed_at, create_time) values (#{gameSessionId}, #{activityId}, #{stationRunId}, #{nodeId}, #{teamId}, #{memberId}, #{status}, #{completionSource}, #{sourceSubmissionId}, #{sourceReceiptId}, #{fallbackPlanCode}, #{fallbackPlanVersion}, #{completedAt}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, game_session_id, activity_id, station_run_id, node_id, team_id, member_id, status, completion_source, source_submission_id, source_receipt_id, fallback_plan_code, fallback_plan_version, completed_at, create_time from game_player_node_outcome where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and member_id=#{memberId} and node_id=#{nodeId} limit 1

select id, game_session_id, activity_id, station_run_id, node_id, team_id, member_id, status, completion_source, source_submission_id, source_receipt_id, fallback_plan_code, fallback_plan_version, completed_at, create_time from game_player_node_outcome where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and member_id=#{memberId} order by id

select node_id as nodeId, max(cast(json_unquote(json_extract(result_json, '$.hint.currentLevel')) as unsigned)) as currentLevel from game_command_receipt where game_session_id=#{sessionId} and actor_member_id=#{memberId} and action='PLAYER_HINT' and outcome='APPLIED' and json_valid(result_json)=1 and json_extract(result_json, '$.hint.currentLevel') is not null group by node_id
mapper.insert: insert into game_broadcast (game_session_id, activity_id, sender_member_id, target_type, target_id, role_code, content, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{gameSessionId}, #{activityId}, #{senderMemberId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{roleCode}, #{content}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

insert ignore into game_broadcast_delivery (broadcast_id, member_id, status, message_id, error_code, create_time, update_time) select distinct #{broadcastId}, m.member_id, 'PENDING', null, null, #{now}, #{now} from play_team t join play_team_member m on m.team_id=t.id and m.status=1 left join game_team_role_assignment r on r.game_session_id=#{sessionId} and r.team_id=t.id and r.member_id=m.member_id and r.status in ('ASSIGNED','CONFIRMED') where t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=#{activityId} and t.status in (0,1,2) and
and t.id=#{targetId} and r.role_code=#{roleCode} and 1=1
mapper.select: select id, broadcast_id, member_id, status, message_id, error_code, create_time, update_time from game_broadcast_delivery where broadcast_id=#{broadcastId} and status='PENDING' order by id
mapper.update: update game_broadcast_delivery set status='PENDING', error_code=null, update_time=#{now} where broadcast_id=#{broadcastId} and status='FAILED'
update game_broadcast_delivery set status=#{status}, message_id=#{messageId}, error_code=#{errorCode}, update_time=#{now} where id=#{id} and status='PENDING'
mapper.select: select count(1) from game_broadcast_delivery where broadcast_id=#{broadcastId} and status=#{status}
mapper.update: update game_broadcast set status=#{toStatus}, update_time=#{now} where id=#{id} and status=#{fromStatus}
mapper.select: select id, game_session_id, activity_id, sender_member_id, target_type, target_id, role_code, content, status, create_time, update_time from game_broadcast where game_session_id=#{sessionId} order by id desc limit 50

select row_number() over(order by scored.score desc, scored.teamId asc) as `rank`, scored.teamId, scored.displayName, scored.score from ( select t.id as teamId, coalesce(t.title, '队伍') as displayName, count(distinct case when o.status='COMPLETED' then o.node_id end) as score from play_team t join game_session s on s.id=#{sessionId} and t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=s.activity_id left join game_player_node_outcome o on o.game_session_id=s.id and o.team_id=t.id group by t.id, t.title ) scored order by `rank`

select m.member_id as memberId, coalesce(u.nickname, '玩家') as displayName, r.role_code as roleCode, coalesce((select case o.status when 'COMPLETED' then 'COMPLETED' when 'FALLBACK_COMPLETED' then 'FALLBACK_COMPLETED' else 'CONFIRMED' end from game_player_node_outcome o where o.game_session_id=#{sessionId} and o.team_id=#{teamId} and o.member_id=m.member_id order by o.id desc limit 1), (select case q.status when 'PENDING' then 'SUBMITTED' else 'CONFIRMED' end from game_task_submission q where q.game_session_id=#{sessionId} and q.team_id=#{teamId} and q.member_id=m.member_id order by q.id desc limit 1), r.status, 'JOINED') as status from play_team_member m join game_session s on s.id=#{sessionId} join play_team t on t.id=#{teamId} and t.owner_type=2 and t.owner_id=s.activity_id left join ums_member u on u.id=m.member_id left join game_team_role_assignment r on r.game_session_id=s.id and r.team_id=t.id and r.member_id=m.member_id and r.status in ('ASSIGNED','CONFIRMED') where m.team_id=#{teamId} and m.status=1 and order by m.id
